steps.what: Review patient treatment information and identify nursing observations and questions for the multidisciplinary team
outputs: verified nursing contribution and treatment questions

steps.what: Collaborate with multidisciplinary team members to plan, manage and assess patient treatments
inputs: verified nursing contribution and treatment questions

tasks.design: Retain multidisciplinary collaboration with current clinical records {OTHER}. No generated care plan or automated team decision substitutes for reconciling professional views and agreeing responsibilities.
tasks.previous_blocker: Different professional assessments must be understood and reconciled for this patient.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing records support shared discussion without a new model.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve disagreement and uncertainty while keeping the patient's goals in view.
tasks.human_edge: Bring direct nursing knowledge and challenge an incomplete treatment understanding.

reach.learn: Which nursing observations affect the shared plan

evidence.claim: Documentation drafting does not establish reduced multidisciplinary treatment discussion time.

assumptions: Care staff produce current records and assessments during existing care; the nurse verifies their relevance and captures questions in s1.
All discussion, agreement and responsibility capture remain in s2; no free structured consensus feed is assumed.
This broad collaboration task overlaps participation in care meetings; overlapping baselines must not be added.
Other team members' work is unchanged outside focal savings; no new tool or upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Current collaboration format and unresolved questions
research_questions: Which treatment assumptions repeatedly need clarification between disciplines?

already_counted.description: Preparation and collaborative treatment work remain fully counted.

incremental.description: No new collaboration tool or maintenance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and no incremental work give zero saving. No preparation or discussion time is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Ask family members or caregivers about their understanding, capacity, concerns and support circumstances
Assess family members' or caregivers' needs, confirm understanding and record support concerns
outputs: documented caregiver or family needs and support concerns

tasks.design: Retain conversation and contextual needs assessment, recording the nurse's findings in the existing clinical record {OTHER}. No caregiver scoring model or self-service form replaces elicitation and confirmation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Caregiver capacity and concerns can be sensitive, incomplete or difficult to express.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing conversation and records support the task without a new model.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguish stated willingness from practical capacity and recognise unspoken concerns.
tasks.human_edge: Build trust and check what the family or caregiver actually needs.
tasks.altitude: Ground support needs in a real understanding of circumstances.

reach.task: Receive clarified family or caregiver support concerns
reach.learn: Which practical barriers require further assessment

evidence.claim: A clinical record drafting capability does not establish reduced caregiver needs assessment time.

assumptions: Family and caregivers produce their account during s1; all elicitation and clarification time remains.
The nurse produces the needs assessment and captures support concerns in s2, with full time retained.
Existing care staff supply patient context; no newly structured caregiver capacity feed or automatic score is assumed.
Family time and downstream support work remain unchanged outside focal savings; no new upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Current assessment approach and support referral options
research_questions: Which caregiver concerns are most often missed without follow-up questions?

already_counted.description: Conversation, assessment and findings capture remain fully counted.

incremental.description: No new assessment system or maintenance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and zero incremental work yield zero saving. No conversation or needs judgement is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review the care meeting purpose and prepare relevant nursing observations and questions
outputs: prepared nursing observations and meeting questions

steps.what: Participate in patients' care meetings and conferences and clarify decisions and assigned follow-up
inputs: prepared nursing observations and meeting questions
outputs: shared nursing contribution and clarified follow-up responsibilities

tasks.design: Retain preparation and active meeting participation using current clinical records {OTHER} and existing meeting documents {DOCS}. No meeting bot represents the nurse or creates an unverified clinical decision record.
tasks.previous_blocker: The meeting requires nursing judgement and clarification with the other participants.
tasks.enabler_now: Current records and meeting channels support this unchanged task.
tasks.still_hard: Make relevant concerns heard and ensure follow-up responsibilities are understood.
tasks.human_edge: Challenge ambiguity and contribute direct knowledge of the patient.
tasks.altitude: Useful and accountable care meeting participation.

reach.task: Clarify unresolved decisions and follow-up ownership
reach.learn: Which nursing concerns require explicit discussion

evidence.claim: Clinical note drafting does not establish that active care meeting participation takes less time.

assumptions: The chair produces the agenda and care staff produce existing patient records; the nurse prepares observations and questions in s1 with all capture time retained.
All discussion and clarification of follow-up remain in s2; no free structured decision feed is assumed.
This task overlaps broader multidisciplinary collaboration, so their baselines are not additive.
Meeting scheduling and other participants' labour remain unchanged outside focal savings; no new upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Meeting format and existing follow-up documentation
research_questions: Which decisions leave meetings without clear follow-up ownership?

already_counted.description: Preparation and meeting participation remain fully counted.

incremental.description: No new meeting service or maintenance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and zero incremental work give zero saving. No meeting attendance or clinical contribution time is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Keep current with acute care literature and professional exchange

steps.what: Find current acute care literature and professional events relevant to identified learning questions
outputs: selected literature and professional learning opportunities

steps.what: Read current literature and critically appraise its methods, limits and relevance to acute care
inputs: selected literature and professional learning opportunities
outputs: appraised evidence and questions for professional discussion

steps.what: Discuss developments with colleagues and participate in professional organisations or conferences
inputs: appraised evidence and questions for professional discussion
selected literature and professional learning opportunities
outputs: updated professional understanding and unresolved practice questions

tasks.design: Configure native saved-search and event alerts in existing literature services {OTHER}, delivered through {EMAIL}. The nurse selects relevant material and reads full sources using {DOCS}; appraisal, colleague exchange and conference participation keep their time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant publications and events are repeatedly located across existing listings.
tasks.enabler_now: Native search alerts can surface matching titles and events deterministically without generating clinical summaries.
tasks.still_hard: Judge study quality, generalisability and whether a development changes understanding.
tasks.human_edge: Read critically and test interpretation through professional discussion.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated discovery and retain deep professional learning.

reach.task: Refine search coverage for acute care learning questions
reach.learn: Which terms and source filters miss relevant evidence

evidence.claim: Native literature and event alerts are an E1 design proposal; the digest does not provide a measured acute care learning case.

assumptions: The nurse produces learning questions and saved-search terms during rollout; recurring refinement time is counted below.
Publishers and professional organisations produce titles, dates, abstracts and event listings as part of existing publication work; no newly cleaned evidence feed is assumed.
s1 retains relevance screening and event checks; full reading and appraisal in s2 are not replaced by abstracts or generated summaries.
Use native subscriptions first; absent full-text access or poor coverage returns to manual search with no saving.
Colleague and conference time remains unchanged; clinical protocol changes require their separate existing governance process.
unknowns: Available literature services, access and manual discovery share
research_questions: Do alerts reduce repeated searching without missing relevant studies or adding excessive screening?

already_counted.description: Full reading, appraisal and professional exchange remain fully counted.

incremental.description: Nurse refines terms and reviews source coverage.
Librarian assists occasional search coverage review.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=10+45+35=90; gross 10 less 1 focal search upkeep gives net 9. High requires repeated manual discovery; low covers noisy alerts, existing subscriptions or access gaps. Reading and professional exchange are unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Preserve multidisciplinary judgement and family understanding while simplifying repeated discovery of learning resources.
reach: Share caregiver concerns with care coordination
Refine literature coverage with a librarian
role.ambitious_version: An acute care nurse who learns from reliable sources and brings informed, patient-specific judgement to teams and families.
